page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. The server features 32 dedicated physical cores utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor, operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. The processor includes a 33 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AVX512_BF16, which accelerate vector and deep learning workloads.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates balanced performance characteristics. Its memory subsystem achieves a strong write bandwidth of 93.48 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, placing it in the top 25% of tested hardware. Read bandwidth reaches 1856.97 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 165.51 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Multi-core processing capabilities are highlighted by a stress-ng multi-core score of 33012.14 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 125.32 GB/sec. However, the instance lacks local NVMe storage, requiring external block storage attachment, and features a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density, the ecs.hfr7.8xlarge offers a stable resource profile for memory-intensive applications without the overhead of hyperthreading. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs positions this instance as a cost-efficient choice for workloads that prioritize raw memory capacity and CPU performance over local disk I/O. It is highly suitable for in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, large-scale caching layers, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
